title: Rollout preview: collapsible panels accessibility redlines & prototype handoff
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Finalize the rollout preview panel pattern that collapses groups of route variants, surface failure states, and show live cost deltas while meeting a11y and motion guidelines. This ticket consolidates feedback across two stakeholder reviews and produces a dev-ready prototype + redlines for engineering handoff.

Scope: compact and expanded panel states; keyboard navigation and focus management; reduced-motion alternative; color contrast for warning/failed states; microinteraction timing for expand/collapse; content prioritization in very narrow widths.

Decisions made so far:
- Use summary/header as the keyboard affordance with explicit aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- Collapse animation reduced to 120ms ease-out; add reduced-motion breakpoints to collapse instantly if user preference is set.
- Cost delta badges are right-aligned and optionally hidden behind a toggle in very small viewports to avoid truncation.
- Failure state uses red-600 with 3:1 icon contrast and a dark label background to meet WCAG AA for text on background; callout copy shortened to one sentence with a learn-more link to rollout details.
- Defer nested list virtualization to a later engineering spike; current prototype uses progressive disclosure only.

Trade-offs and open questions:
- We intentionally avoid animated height expansion on large lists to keep CPU usage low; this improves perceived latency but loses continuous motion for long lists. Engineering should quantify render cost for 100+ rows in dedicated mode.
- Should collapsed groups remember their state per-route vs per-session? For MVP we persist in session only; long-term persistence is a follow-up.

Handoff artifacts included below and redlines are attached to the Figma frames. Engineering tasks recommended: keyboard QA, screenreader sweep on Mac VoiceOver + NVDA, performance check with 200 simulated rollout variants, unit tests for aria attributes.

QA checklist (design):
- [ ] Keyboard focus order stable for expand/collapse and inline actions
- [ ] Reduced-motion honored when OS flag enabled
- [ ] Contrast ratios verified for all states at 14px small caps and 16px body
- [ ] Expand/collapse timing matches redlines (120ms)
- [ ] Tooltip and error copy confirmed with PM

Expected follow-ups: add toggle to hide cost deltas for sensitive customers; investigate persisted collapse state; tie rollout failure reasons to troubleshooting doc in Console docs.
